src='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Extend the first row of the lower colored pattern with marker color 1.
    colored=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v not in (0,1) for v in row)]
    r=colored[len(colored)//2] if colored else 0
    # Select first row in lower separated component
    runs=[]
    for i in colored:
        if not runs or i>runs[-1][-1]+1: runs.append([i])
        else: runs[-1].append(i)
    r=runs[-1][0]
    last=max(j for j,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v not in (0,1))
    for j in range(last+1,len(out[r])): out[r][j]=1
    return out
'''
